verdict.rationale: Whether a documentation platform's source is available under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. No first-party evidence shows Mintlify publishing its source under an open license. The only relevant item is a community comment stating Mintlify is not open source and that its backend enterprise features are source-available only; self-hosting and the CLI are deployment features, not an open-source license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
